key_insight: OfficeQA Pro provides a high-fidelity, enterprise-scale benchmark that stresses end-to-end grounded reasoning across 89,000 pages of heterogeneous documents and tables, forcing models to combine precise retrieval, parsing, and numeric analysis across long historical records.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of realistic benchmarks for multi-document, numeric- and table-heavy grounded reasoning needed for enterprise tasks like auditing, compliance, and financial analysis.
method: Curate a large corpus of U.S. Treasury Bulletins (~89k pages, >26M numerical values) spanning ~100 years to represent heterogeneous, real-world enterprise documents.
Design 133 targeted questions that require document-level retrieval, fine-grained parsing of unstructured text and tabular data, and multi-step analytical reasoning across documents.
Evaluate end-to-end agent performance (retrieval → parsing → answer + evidence) to reveal capability gaps in frontier LLMs on precise, grounded tasks.
impact: Provides practitioners and researchers a realistic stress-test for document-understanding and grounded decision-making, enabling development of more reliable retrieval-augmented agents for enterprise and regulatory use cases.
visual_elements: Corpus overview: stacked timeline or archival stack showing 100-year span, 89k pages, and >26M numeric values (big-number callouts).
Question pipeline diagram: Retrieval → Document Parsing (text + tables) → Multi-document Reasoning → Answer + Evidence.
Example QA walkthrough: one sample question with highlighted source passages/tables and stepwise numeric reasoning (annotated).
Model comparison placeholder: bar or radar chart showing relative error types (retrieval, parsing, math) across evaluated systems.
paper_title: OfficeQA Pro: An Enterprise Benchmark for End-to-End Grounded Reasoning
paper_authors: Krista Opsahl-Ong, Arnav Singhvi, Jasmine Collins, Ivan Zhou, Cindy Wang
